description: Single source of truth for the SDK's quality tasks: which check_*.py gates exist, whether each is a hard CI gate or informational, and which profiles (quick/pr/full/release) run it. check_quality_registry.py keeps it == scripts/check_*.py on disk and (#1463 round 2) enforces `quick`'s own membership bar: non-empty, a subset of `pr`, and no member's script executing `import subprocess` at module load time. Additive-only within schemaVersion 1. `quick` membership criterion (#1463, measured against the `pr` set): pure-Python (no `subprocess` call of any kind -- not even `git`), no build/toolchain dependency, and a median wall-clock time under 0.5s (median of 5 interleaved reps on an otherwise-idle checkout -- a sequential sweep under load inverts this measurement, don't trust one of those). The subprocess/toolchain exclusion is a hermeticity rule, not a speed rule: `quick` must stay runnable in a dirty working tree or a bare checkout with no `git`/`west` on PATH, which is why it excludes some of the fastest gates in the whole registry (e.g. changelog-citations at ~0.05s) alongside genuinely slow ones -- do not read the exclusion as "shells out, therefore slow". Add `quick` only once you've measured a task against this bar, not by assuming a short script qualifies.

tasks.description: AGENTS.md's ALP_E1M_*/ALP_E1M_X_* identifiers and --emit choice lists must exist in the real generators (#1264).

No Linux devicetree pad claim (RZV2N_GPIO / RZV2N_PORT_PINMUX under meta-alp-sdk/recipes-kernel/linux/) lands on an RZ/V2N pad metadata/pinmux/v2n.yaml attributes to the CM33 -- the errata E3 P9.6/SCK7 clobber class (#1142).

No .github/workflows/*.yml step calls apt-get update/install directly -- Acquire::http::Timeout bounds an idle read, not a trickling one, so it must go through scripts/ci/apt-bounded.sh's wall-clock retry wrapper (#1575).

Every AEN board .dts and every SoM preset memory_map reserves the top of the App MRAM window as an 'atoc' region -- SETOOLS top-anchors the ATOC boot table there (#1289) -- and every AEN board .dts with an m55_he/m55_hp role publishes a slot0 flash address that agrees with loader._resolve_slot0_load_address() (#1482).
docs/board-id.md's alp_hw_info_eeprom_t typedef struct (field names, order, widths) must match include/alp/hw_info.h, macros resolved (#1231).
Fail if any repo board.yaml has an outstanding schema migration.
Every SoM preset's topology.<core>.board: target resolves to a real zephyr/boards/alp/ tree, or is a declared not-yet-supported entry (issue #999).
Keep metadata/bootstrap.json in lockstep with west.yml, both bootstrap scripts, and each CI workflow's own Zephyr pin.
Validate a build plan against the public alp CLI / alp-sdk-vscode contract, plus (for SDK-generated plans) the command.tool bare-identity convention the schema itself deliberately does not assert.
Validate the build-receipt-v1 schema is a well-formed closed Draft-2020-12 schema.
Every changelog.d/*.md fragment is well-formed (foldable filename, non-empty, starts with its own ### heading) so a malformed fragment fails the PR instead of the release cut (#1395).

Every `path:line` citation in a changelog.d/*.md fragment resolves to a real file and an in-range line, and an anchored citation's quoted text is still inside the cited range, so a release note cannot point at code that moved (#1416).
CI gate: chip-header `@par Driver status:` labels match metadata truth.
Chip driver <-> manifest parity gate -- fails when a chip driver ships without its manifest, or vice versa.
_CHIP_SUBSYSTEMS <-> Kconfig depends-on parity gate -- fails when a chip's Zephyr subsystem dependency isn't mirrored from zephyr/kconfigs/chips.kconfig.
Plain-CMake chip-list parity gate -- fails when ALP_SDK_CHIP_LIST drifts from the drivers under chips/<id>/.

Every enabled Zephyr core's board.yaml app: must resolve to a CMakeLists.txt baked with that SAME core's --core literal, and no two distinct cores may resolve to the same CMakeLists.txt (issue #1275: a dual-core SKU can silently share one core's Kconfig fragment with another).
Lint repo content for Linux-only idioms in customer-facing surfaces.
Every ALP-Bxxx code scripts/alp_cli/validator.py can emit must have a docs/diagnostics/ALP-Bxxx.md landing page (#1569).
Reject a placeholder-only ALP-Bxxx diagnostic landing page under docs/diagnostics/ -- every page must carry a real narrative and a Fix/Resolution/Remedy section (#1207).
Validate the versioned machine diagnostics contract, including a real document produced by the actual emitter.
Doc-drift gate -- fails when customer-facing documentation drifts from the code it documents.
Doc-stated workflow names/counts and ADR/chip/library counts must match the tree (#1265).
Fail on a dead relative-path Markdown link in customer-facing documentation (#1213).
No second Doxyfile-shaped heredoc regrows in .github/workflows/** or scripts/** while docs/doxygen/Doxyfile is the committed single source (#970).
Doxygen-coverage audit -- walks include/alp/*.h and flags every undocumented public symbol.
No tracked file lives under Doxygen's OUTPUT_DIRECTORY (docs/doxygen/Doxyfile) -- it is a generated build artifact, not source (#1573).

driver_status declarations outside metadata/chips/*.yaml (mailbox.driver_status, on_module.{nor_flash,emmc}_driver_status, soc_peripheral_instances[].driver_status) are bound to a real zephyr/drivers/** artefact when they claim partial/complete (issue #1216).
Validate the vendored e1m-spec pinout snapshot and cross-check it against SoM pin-mux tables.
E1M board-route <-> SoM capability-table end-to-end gate.
CI schema/smoke contract for --emit kconfig (#893); needs a bootstrapped Zephyr workspace (ZEPHYR_BASE), unlike every other hermetic gate in this registry.
Validate metadata/emit-registry-v1.json against the public IDE/tool contract and the real --emit surface.
Byte-for-byte `--emit` snapshot regression gate.
Every example board.yaml core declared via cores.<core>.app: has a matching boards/ overlay wherever the example ships qualified overlays (issue #1009).
Cross-family portability lint for examples/*/{board.yaml,testcase.yaml}.

No examples/**/CMakeLists.txt reaches scripts/alp_project.py through a bare relative hop; every invocation resolves it under ${ALP_SDK_ROOT} so the example still builds scaffolded out of tree (issue #1390).
Reject examples that claim Alp storage coverage while using Zephyr storage APIs.
Every metadata/e1m_modules/*.yaml helper_firmware[].firmware_path (when present) resolves to a real file; omission is legal and left alone (issue #1372).
No two declared I2C devices claim the same 7-bit address on the same bus, across metadata/e1m_modules/*.yaml and metadata/boards/*.yaml (issue #1675).
Doc/example prose naming an on-module I2C part next to a bus name must agree with metadata/e1m_modules/*.yaml's on_module.i2c_devices.
Inference backend/format <-> dispatcher canonicalisation gate.
A meta-alp-sdk recipe's SRCREV/tag must match its metadata/libraries version and, when west.yml resolves one, its west grounding (#1281).
Assert the curated-library registry is self-consistent (WS6-c).
CI gate: no hard-coded home-directory paths in executable / build files.
Validate that every silicon pad referenced in the SoM peripheral maps is unique.
Plain-CMake link-completeness gate (issue #593).

CC3501E wire ALP_CC3501E_PROTOCOL_MAJOR/_MINOR must match ADR 0033's Version ledger, the ledger must be monotonic, MAJOR never 0, and every MAJOR row must justify itself with 'an old host would be misread' (ADR 0033).
CI gate: root public headers stay chip-neutral.
Public/private classifier gate for the public alp-sdk repository.
Validate gen_sbom.py produces a valid, deterministic CycloneDX SBOM from alp.lock.
Backend handle pools claim slots with alp_slot_try_claim(), not an unlocked check-then-set (issue #1630).
Validate SoM-release bundle manifests against the public som-release-bundle-v1 schema contract.
Every SoM preset's topology.<core> key set matches its resolved SoC's cores[].id set, and every preset's silicon: key resolves to a real metadata/socs/ spec (issue #997).
CI gate: every src/backends/**/*_stub.c file must reference an open GitHub issue.
Compile/link symbol-matrix gate for the shared stub backend.
CI gate: every src/backends/**/sw_fallback.c carries both Cost and Performance tags.
Validate a system manifest against the public IDE/tool contract.
Advisory: every `tan` subcommand + docs/cli.md-tabulated flag alp-sdk's docs name must exist and be listed in `--help` output for a real, installed `tan` binary.
Validate metadata/templates/catalog-v1.json against the public template contract and drift-check every record against the real tree.
Test-coverage audit: walk every public header in include/alp/ and check each declared function is mentioned by a test.
Keep metadata/toolchains.json (the pinned Zephyr SDK release) in lockstep with Zephyr's own SDK_VERSION and each CI workflow's own SDK reference.
CI gate: every function declaration under include/alp/ext/**/*.h carries a Supported-silicon tag.
Fail if any version copy drifts from the declared SDK version.

Prove every libraries:-selectable Zephyr module resolves to a reachable west.yml project in an alp-sdk-owned workspace, and that no name-allowlist entry is shadowed by a same-named top-level project (#1136).
Reject a jobs.<job_id>.if that references a context GitHub Actions does not expose there (e.g. matrix, steps) -- valid YAML but rejected by GitHub at workflow-load time on every event (#1528).
Every scripts/ and firmware/ write_text() of a repo-tree text artifact passes newline="" (else Windows CRLF-rewrites it silently on write).
Byte-parity gate: an example CMakeLists.txt's --core-scoped alp_project.py --emit zephyr-conf and the planner's build-plan configArtefacts must materialise the identical alp.conf per Zephyr core.
